title: Sleep Position Height Check
cut_style: soft felt craft cutouts with stitched edges and glow-in-the-dark star stickers
voice: Friendly, clear, brisk narrator with a warm app-guide tone, ~170 WPM.

cuts.curled_neck_sleeper: Top-down flat felt craft cutout of a side sleeper curled tightly with chin tucked toward chest, rounded upper back, stitched edges, small glow-in-the-dark star stickers around the blanket, no text.
cuts.neutral_side_sleeper: Top-down flat felt craft cutout of a side sleeper with head, neck, and back aligned in a straight calm posture on a thin pillow, stitched edges, tiny glow-in-the-dark stars, no text.
cuts.back_sleeper_neutral: Top-down flat felt craft cutout of a person lying on their back with relaxed shoulders, straight neck, thin pillow, and long neutral spine posture, stitched edges, glow-in-the-dark stars, no text.
cuts.thin_pillow: Simple flat felt craft cutout of a slim pillow under a relaxed head, showing a level neck with a small gentle alignment line, stitched edges, glow-in-the-dark star stickers, no text.
cuts.uncurl_arrow: Flat felt craft cutout showing a curved arrow guiding a tucked head and neck into a longer neutral position, soft stitched edges, glow-in-the-dark star stickers, no text.

scenes.vo: Does your sleeping position steal your height?
A curled neck can make mornings look shorter.
Back or side keeps your spine neutral.
A thin pillow helps your head stay level.
Tonight, uncurl your neck before you sleep.
Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
